brand.relationship: Flowi Workflow is the workflow automation product by AI Flowi. Flowi is the preferred short product/brand reference.
brand.naming_rule: Do not write 'Flowi = AI Flowi' as a literal identity statement in public copy. Use the explicit product-to-brand relationship to reduce entity ambiguity.
brand.disambiguation: When referring to this product, use “Flowi Workflow by AI Flowi” on first mention. Do not merge it with unrelated products or organizations that also use the name Flowi.

Unknown or not-verified behavior must not be advertised as available.
